outcome: emergency cesarean section related to non-reassuring fetal status
cohort: The study included 206 mothers at 37, 38, and 39 weeks' gestation who delivered at the study institution between January 2021 and October 2022.
finding: The success rate of vaginal delivery was significantly higher in the PGE(2) group (80.4%) compared to the non-PGE(2) group (66.2%) for elective labor induction between 37 and 39 weeks.
mod_finding: The rate of vaginal delivery was significantly higher in the PGE(2) group for elective labor induction between 37 and 39 weeks.
